title: L9 post-publish governance handoff (l9.governance_handoff.v1)
description: Environment, bootstrap and governance material ONLY, written by the agent to .l9/memory/governance-handoff.json after make pr. The parallel Stop hook governance_handoff_writeback.py writes it as ONE observation record to the cursor-governance namespace, never the repository's, through the namespace-restricted hook surface claude-governance-handoff. The hook appends an 'observed' block copied verbatim from receipts (bootstrap receipt when not ready, degraded prefetch receipt, hook skips since session start); that block is not part of this file. Enforced by ops/memory/governance_handoff.py; also enforced there: the normalized brief is at most 12288 bytes and the record at most 16384 bytes. An all-empty brief with nothing observed writes no record.

pr_number.description: The published PR's number. Must equal the number in .l9/pr/pr-summary.json written by make pr, or the brief is not this publication's and is refused.

items.description: What got in the way in the environment: evidence (detail) and cost (impact). A bare string is accepted and becomes {"item": <string>}.

item.description: Required. Whitespace is collapsed; longer than 1200 characters is truncated with an ellipsis.

detail.description: Optional. Empty or absent is omitted.

impact.description: Optional. Empty or absent is omitted.
